The following events took place in '''3694 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] charted the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Spur]] from the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]] to the [[Denon system/Legends|Denon system]] and blazed another [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] from the [[Corsin system/Legends|Corsin system]] to the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*The Hydian Way, now mostly mapped out, received its name from Kallea in honor of her [[Death/Legends|fallen]] friend [[Banu Hydia]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Deaths==
*Banu Hydia on [[Imynusoph/Legends|Imynusoph]]<ref name="TEA" />

*<!-- 2009-08-18 -->''[[The Essential Atlas]]''
